extraction_scope: Worker-6 replaced automated mechanism placeholders with source-reviewed, bounded mechanism/activity ontology claims.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The source supports broad-spectrum antibacterial activity and PAO1 bactericidal activity for α4-short, including Table 2 MIC values and Fig. 2 PAO1 MBC context.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Recorded as phenotypic antibacterial activity, not as a resolved molecular killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The source supports antibiofilm activity across crystal violet, bead-transfer, and biotic coculture assay contexts.
direct_assay_types: biotic airway epithelial coculture biofilm assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biofilm phenotype is source-supported; exact figure-only percentages are not converted into fabricated tabular values.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Design rationale links the 24-residue sequence and increased cationic/amphipathic character to improved activity relative to the parent α4 motif.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is structure-activity rationale from sequence/physicochemical context, not independent proof of a membrane-pore mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The mouse airway infection model supports in vivo efficacy context through reduced bacterial burden and inflammatory cytokine readouts after intratracheal administration.
mechanism_claims.limitations: In vivo efficacy is retained as disease-model evidence and not overclassified as a direct antimicrobial molecular mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Membrane perturbation is discussed as AMP class context, but this local paper does not provide a direct membrane-disruption assay for α4-short.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Preserves the membrane-mechanism caveat instead of promoting discussion context to direct mechanism evidence.
